source_text: Manus testium primi; lapidabit eum omnis populus. Testimonium grave. Veritas non otiosa.
thought_title: The first witnesses cast the stone
orientation: Origen is commenting on the expulsion of the blasphemer from the camp, now describing the execution by stoning and the role of the witnesses.
pass_a_gloss: The hand of the witnesses first; all the people will stone him. A weighty testimony. Truth is not idle.

choices.english: The hand of the witnesses first
choices.why: Keeps the genitive construction and the adverbial force of 'primi' as 'first' in action, matching the legal sequence in Leviticus 24:14.
rejected: First the hands of the witnesses

choices.english: all the people will stone him
choices.why: Preserves the future tense and the collective subject 'omnis populus' as 'all the people', matching the communal execution.
Renders 'grave' as 'weighty' to convey the seriousness and burden of witness-bearing, not merely 'serious'.
Keeps the negative adjective 'otiosa' as 'idle' to preserve the sense that truth acts and bears witness, not passive.

problems.fix: The hand of the witnesses is first; all the people will stone him. A weighty testimony. Truth is not idle.
problems.ruling: Source has no parenthetical citation; English adds '(Leviticus 24:14)' not in Latin text.
